meaning: He who would be king — that leadership begins in service
note: From “Nea ope se obedi hene daakye no firi asee sua som ansa”: he who wants to be king in the future begins by learning how to serve.
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
